title: Fare versus base price
statementMd:
For each booking made in economy class on flight 1 to 20, show the booking id and the ratio of fare to the flight's base price rounded to 2 decimals.

Expected columns: `id`, `ratio`.

Tables: `airlines`, `airports`, `flights`, `bookings`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT b.id, ROUND(b.fare / f.base_price, 2) AS ratio FROM bookings b JOIN flights f ON f.id = b.flight_id WHERE b.seat_class = 'economy' AND f.id <= 20;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
